data.scifact_attribution: Wadden et al. 2020; BEIR by Thakur et al. 2021
data.scope: Fresh QA subset and label-informed 1000-document scientific corpus with document-level judgments

manifest.background_load: Shared Windows desktop; applications left running

previous_import.reason: Reuse identical scientific corpus batches; safe optional dependency reporting. Encoding semantics, model registry and prepared data unchanged.

pre_score_cache_import.reason: Atomic checkpoint metadata and exact rank-order validation. Model registry, vector arithmetic and prepared data unchanged.

cost_forecast_scope: Conservative original request-volume upper estimate counts shared scientific corpus twice; no API calls executed.

squad.objectives: Maximize exact nDCG@10; minimize query p95, encoder peak RSS and FP32 snapshot bytes
squad.scope: Point estimates only; sampling intervals and uncontrolled runtime load can change dominance

scifact.objectives: Maximize exact nDCG@10; minimize query p95, encoder peak RSS and FP32 snapshot bytes
scifact.scope: Point estimates only; sampling intervals and uncontrolled runtime load can change dominance

generator_runtime_memory.boundary: Model-runtime process samples after requests; lifetime peaks are individual process peaks, not a sum of simultaneous peaks; Python client/encoders separate

supplemental_timing_audit.purpose: Separate small timing diagnostic following observed sleep/standby interruptions; primary metrics and selection retained

timing_interruption_evidence.interpretation: Windows sleep/standby events occurred during collection; precise per-batch CPU/sleep split was not recorded. Raw elapsed observations remain in primary results.
